text:
Interlock chain, sheet 3 — cell 3

Callout SF121.1) marks the guard interlock chain carried over from the previous
revision. Sheet 13 continues the chain into the second door.
summary: Sheet 3 carries the guard interlock chain and its callout, and hands the chain on to sheet 13 for the second door.
note: F3 — the compact printed form. `lookup("SF 121.1")` reaches it through the whitespace-removed variant: Qdrant's WORD tokenizer reads `SF121.1)` as [sf121, 1], which the spaced phrase [sf, 121, 1] cannot match.
